stories.title: Source: Giants' Austin (torn ACL) out for season
stories.summary: Giants wide receiver Calvin Austin III will miss the upcoming season after suffering a torn ACL in his right knee while running a route at Tuesday's training camp practice, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Sources: Buccaneers top pick Bain has AC sprain
stories.summary: Buccaneers rookie pass rusher Rueben Bain Jr. suffered an AC sprain, but it is said to be "nothing serious," and he is expected to be ready Week 1, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Cubs set club record with 30th unanswered run
stories.summary: The Cubs set a franchise record Tuesday by scoring their 30th unanswered run over three games, breaking the previous record of 29 over a three-game stretch in 1969.
